csv_project_name: Design Svc for Wegerzyn Gardens MetroPark
csv_scope_of_work: Five Rivers MetroParks (FRMP) is requesting statements of qualification from qualified consultants to develop plans from conceptual design to construction documentation for the following: Campus Visioning & Central Operations Center . The scope involves a conceptual visioning exercise and a technical implementation project. The final scope will be negotiated with the selected consultant. Main Campus Visioning (Conceptual Only) Schematic Programming & Graphics: Collaborate with staff to develop high-level project goals, site narratives, and conceptual alternatives using new and established programming data. Visionary Deliverables: Provide illustrative plans and graphics communicating the "Main Campus" concept and a concept-level cost estimate. This component remains schematic and will not proceed to construction documentation. Operations Center (Project Priority) Design Development: Create detailed layouts for specialized maintenance shops, vehicle staging, and shared office cores. Construction Documents: Produce a complete, biddable construction package including all technical drawings and specifications. Budgeting & Estimating: Provide detailed cost estimates at each phase to ensure the project is positioned for a successful bid and award in FY 2027. Construction Observation: MetroParks may require architectural and site-specific construction observation services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Cost Estimating, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning
